# Nofinite Open Source Documentation Index

Welcome to the LLM index for Nofinite Open-Source libraries.

## Package Documentation
- [NUI Component Library (/nui)](/nui/llms.txt): Accessible, composable React UI primitives with strict semantic design tokens.
- [Nuicss Design Token & Utility Engine (/nuicss)](/nuicss/llms.txt): Semantic CSS utility framework and runtime-less design token engine.
- [Locale Utilities & Country Data (/locale)](/locale/llms.txt): Lightweight localization, country lookups, dialing codes, and flag utilities.
- [Markon Markdown Parser & Renderer (/markon)](/markon/llms.txt): High-speed AST-based Markdown and MDX processing toolkit.
- [Nofinite Shared Utilities (/utils)](/utils/llms.txt): Shared TypeScript helpers, class name merge (cn), formatters, and custom hooks.

## Global Bundles
- [Unified Ecosystem Bundle (All Packages)](/llms-full.txt)
